371:t_1:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
(So $c has headed for Japan... If I don't take them down there, I truly have no way out.)

371:t_1:5.en:
$$ギルター$$
(Is there any useful data here...? Something that could serve as a weakness of theirs...)

371:t_1:10.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「It's been a while, Captain $$ブライト$$.」

371:t_1:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It's been too long, $$兵左衛門$$. I'm glad to see you looking so well.」

371:t_1:12.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「We can't offer much, but you should resupply here to some extent before you go.」

371:t_1:13.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「Later, I'll also act as go-between for the Resistance groups of Japan and the Central Continent.」

371:t_1:14.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I can't thank you enough for everything.」

371:t_1:15.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「You looked after us plenty in the $$多元戦争$$. And now you're looking after $$勝平$$ and the others too.」

371:t_1:16.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「Beal is in the hands of $$源五郎$$ and the others, you see. I may be living in retirement, but leave this much to me.」

371:t_1:17.en:
$$勝平$$
「What are you talking about, Grandpa? You're a strategy adviser for Resistance groups all over the place!」

371:t_1:18.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「These are the times we live in, after all. If this old wreck can be of use, I'll gladly lend a hand.」

371:t_1:19.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Now that's the elder of the $$神ファミリー$$ for you! What presence!」

371:t_1:20.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「So you're $$ワッ太$$. I hear you looked after $$勝平$$, $$宇宙太$$ and $$恵子$$ in the $$ＡＤＷ$$.」

371:t_1:21.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Not at all, $$兵左衛門$$. $$宇宙太$$'s accounting skills and $$恵子$$'s clerical skills were a great help to our company.」

371:t_1:22.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Should the two of them ever be unsure of their path, please do encourage them to consider a career at $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$.」

371:t_1:23.en:
$$勝平$$
「Tch... Don't I count at all, Executive Director?」

371:t_1:24.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「In your case, you were only useful as a playmate for $$ワッ太$$.」

371:t_1:25.en:
$$恵子$$
「But once there's peace, couldn't $$ザンボット３$$ be used as an odd-jobs robot, like $$トライダーＧ７$$?」

371:t_1:26.en:
$$勝平$$
「Yeah. Then instead of getting hired by $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$, starting up $$神$$ Great Company might be nice too.」

371:t_1:27.en:
$$勝平$$
「Well, I'll rake in enough to give some hopeless excuse for a president a run for his money.」

371:t_1:29.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hey, you! You actually said it!」

371:t_1:30.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You're the one who picked the fight first!」

371:t_1:31.en:
$$勝平$$
「Shut up! Don't get so high and mighty just because you had us on the payroll for a while!」

371:t_1:32.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I hired you out of kindness! And this is how you talk about it!?」

371:t_1:33.en:
$$赤木$$
「Cut it out, you two! What's the point of fighting in a place like this!?」

371:t_1:34.en:
$$勝平$$
「Stay out of it, Big Bro $$赤木$$!」

371:t_1:35.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Right! This is a fight over my pride and grit as a president!」

371:t_1:36.en:
$$柿小路$$
「What shall we do, $$兵左衛門$$?」

371:t_1:37.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「We can simply leave them be. Once they get hungry, it'll settle down on its own.」

371:t_1:38.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「From what I can see, those two are the best of friends and the best of rivals.」

371:t_1:39.en:
$$一太郎$$
「Come to think of it, $$ザンボット３$$ and $$トライダーＧ７$$ use technology of the same lineage, don't they...」

371:t_1:40.en:
$$一太郎$$
「Oh... I'm sorry for the late introduction. I'm $$神一太郎$$... $$勝平$$'s older brother.」

371:t_1:41.en:
$$いぶき$$
「I've heard about you from $$勝平$$.」

371:t_1:42.en:
$$青山$$
「According to him, you're a big brother who turned out better than he did... or so he says.」

371:t_1:43.en:
$$一太郎$$
「No... I can't compare to $$勝平$$, who rides $$ザンボット３$$ and fights on the front line.」

371:t_1:44.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Weren't you taking part in the Resistance together with Dad and the others, $$一太郎$$?」

371:t_1:45.en:
$$一太郎$$
「Right now I'm working as an engineer, researching the technology of $$ビアル星$$.」

371:t_1:46.en:
$$一太郎$$
「I found a lot of interesting material, you see.」

371:t_1:47.en:
$$恵子$$
「Is it ancient texts left behind by the $$ビアル星人$$?」

371:t_1:48.en:
$$一太郎$$
「No, that's not it. Someone who knows about the technology of $$ビアル星$$ has been helping us.」

371:t_1:50.en:
$$一太郎$$
「I never learned who this person was, but they went by $$梅本$$.」

371:t_1:52.en:
$$柿小路$$
「$$一太郎$$! Was that person... a man with a big shaggy beard, like so!?」

371:t_1:54.en:
$$厚井$$
「So it really was that $$梅本$$...」

371:t_1:55.en:
$$木下$$
「He certainly did know about the mechanism of $$ザンボット３$$ too, but...」

371:t_1:56.en:
$$郁絵$$
「To think he was on the $$翠の地球$$...」

371:t_1:57.en:
$$厚井$$
「Yes... He's as elusive as ever.」

371:t_1:58.en:
$$一太郎$$
「You must be Managing Director $$厚井$$ of $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$. If you don't mind, could I ask to see the blueprints for $$トライダーＧ７$$?」

371:t_1:59.en:
$$一太郎$$
「There may be parts of them we can use to improve $$ザンボット３$$, you see.」

371:t_1:60.en:
$$厚井$$
「Is that all right with you, President?」

371:t_1:61.en:
$$木下$$
「The President is still over there, fighting with $$勝平$$.」

371:t_1:62.en:
$$厚井$$
「Then we'll process this on the approval of the director in charge. ...I don't mind, $$一太郎$$.」

371:t_1:63.en:
$$勝平$$
「Ha! In Big Bro Ichi's hands, $$ザンボット３$$ will get even stronger than $$トライダーＧ７$$!」

371:t_1:64.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「But with $$勝平$$ as the pilot, it'll be a treasure going to waste!」

371:t_1:67.en:
$$赤木$$
「I said enough already, you two!」

371:t_1:68.en:
$$いぶき$$
「They never get tired of it, do they...」

371:t_1:69.en:
$$青山$$
「$$赤木$$ is pretty impressive too, humoring that childish fight.」

371:t_1:70.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「In any case, you must be tired from the long journey. Do rest a while in Japan first.」

371:t_1:71.en:
$$勝平$$
「Come eat at our place for now! My Mom's oden is tastier than $$ワッ太$$'s Mom's croquettes!」

371:t_1:72.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What are you talking about! You praised my Mom's croquettes as the best in every parallel world!」

371:t_1:73.en:
$$勝平$$
「Then let's have the Managing Director decide! Which one is tastier!」

371:t_1:75.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'm counting on you, Managing Director! Give us a big, flashy verdict!」

371:t_1:76.en:
$$一太郎$$
「Oh, $$勝平$$. Mom and Grandma are out.」

371:t_1:78.en:
$$一太郎$$
「They've gone to volunteer at the refugee camp in Fuji.」

371:t_1:84.en:
$$梅江$$
「Well, well. Chuu-chan and $$恵子$$-chan too.」

371:t_1:85.en:
$$勝平$$
「You two look well, Mom and Grandma.」

371:t_1:86.en:
$$恵子$$
「We heard you two were volunteering here, so we came to help too.」

371:t_1:87.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「And we brought some helpers along.」

371:t_1:88.en:
$$花江$$
「If the famous President $$ワッ太$$ is here too, we ought to say hello.」
